title: OpenText World 2026: What’s in it for you?
summary: Whether you’re a technical doer, a decision maker, or an executive, OpenText World 2026 in Orlando October 19-22 is the conference for you.
body_markdown:
[OpenText Word 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?hp-link=true&_gl=1*umsupe*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mi4xMjI5MzMwNzI1LjE3ODkwNjI0ODAuMTc4OTA2MjQ4MC4xMjAzODc2ODg4LjE3ODkwNjI0ODAuMTc4OTA2MjQ4MA..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODk2NTQ1ODYkbzIyJGcwJHQxNzg5NjU0NTg2JGo2MCRsMCRoODcxNjkyOTIy) in Orlando is just around the corner. Get ready for three days of big ideas, concrete answers, and turning possibilities into outcomes.


Whether you’re looking for practical answers to take back to work with you, information to help you make smarter technology and investment decisions, or inspiration to accelerate your strategic priorities, OpenText World 2026 is the conference for you.


## **For technical doers: Expand your skills**


If you’re the person responsible for making technology work every day, OpenText World lets you dive deeper into the products and capabilities you use most as well as discover new solutions.


This is not three days of high-level conversations detached from reality. It’s an opportunity to explore product features, deployment models, AI capabilities, and technical best practices with the people who build, support, and implement OpenText solutions.


You’ll have the chance to:


- See live demos and participate in hands-on experiences.
- Speak with product managers, developers, technical specialists, and OpenText experts.
- Learn how other clients are solving similar challenges.
- Discover complementary technologies from partners and sponsors.


You’ll also have the chance to validate your expertise in OpenText products with[certification opportunities](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:66191de3-1bf0-4ae6-af2d-a5be40c1359f?hp-link=true&_gl=1*umsupe*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mi4xMjI5MzMwNzI1LjE3ODkwNjI0ODAuMTc4OTA2MjQ4MC4xMjAzODc2ODg4LjE3ODkwNjI0ODAuMTc4OTA2MjQ4MA..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODk2NTQ1ODYkbzIyJGcwJHQxNzg5NjU0NTg2JGo2MCRsMCRoODcxNjkyOTIy) . Each registration includes one complimentary certification attempt.


When you return to work, you’ll have more than presentation slides. You’ll have practical insights, answers to technical challenges, in-depth product knowledge, and ideas you can immediately put into action.


## **For decision makers: Expand your view**


As a business or technology leader, you’re balancing modernization efforts, technology investments, business outcomes, security requirements, and increasing pressure to deliver value from AI initiatives. OpenText World 2026 gives you the opportunity to step back from day-to-day demands and focus on what comes next.


At the event you’ll be able to:


- Gain a deeper understanding of OpenText’s strategic direction and product roadmap.
- Explore deployment options and future technology planning considerations.
- Meet with OpenText experts, executives, implementation teams, and partners.
- Learn from other organizations willing to share what worked, what didn’t, and what they would do differently.
- Hear practical examples of how enterprises are applying AI to their trusted data to solve business problems.
- Discover strategies to transform your OpenText investments into scalable business value and measurable results.
- Build relationships with peers who share similar priorities, goals, and challenges.


Whether you’re evaluating future investments, planning modernization initiatives, or determining how AI fits into your organization’s roadmap, OpenText World gives you access to the people, proof points, and perspectives that can shape your next move.


## **For executives: Expand your reach**


Make the most of your time at OpenText World 2026 by connecting with the people and having the conversations that matter most.


At the event you can:


- Engage directly with OpenText leadership, subject matter experts, and industry strategists.
- Collaborate with account teams and strategic stakeholders on your organization’s priorities.
- Connect with peers at roundtable sessions and networking events, and keep the conversation going on the expo floor, over lunch, and during social hours.


You’ll come away from the conference with new perspectives and insight to help you address complex priorities and accelerate business outcomes.


## **For partners: Expand your business**


From resellers and distributors to GSIs, ISVs, and cloud service providers, OpenText World 2026 gives you a front-row view of our evolving, partner-led approach and the strategy, solutions, and go-to-market priorities shaping the ecosystem.


At the event, you’ll be able to:


- Understand where the business is heading and get closer to OpenText strategy, priorities, and the evolution of our partner-led model so you can align your business plans with what’s ahead.
- Stay ahead of changing client needs by exploring the latest developments in AI, secure information management, and other technologies shaping the market.
- Find new ways to grow by discovering solutions and routes to market that can help you expand your OpenText business and initiate new client conversations.
- Build stronger joint plays by working with OpenText sales and partner teams to identify demand, develop go-to-market approaches, and take solutions to market together.
- Connect with the people who can move business forward by meeting OpenText leaders, sales teams, technology experts, clients, decision makers, and partners from across the ecosystem.
- Get more from your partnership by exploring the latest partner programs, enablement, and resources designed to help you sell, deliver and create greater value for clients.


The experience starts with the[OpenText World Partner Summit](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2b143356-095a-4738-be3d-83623e6db512?environment=P2) on October 19, an exclusive day dedicated to the partner community. Here you’ll get a closer look at our vision for partner-led growth, hear what’s changing across the business, and explore how the latest OpenText innovations can translate into value for your clients and your business.


Whether you’re looking to expand an existing client relationship, build new pipeline, strengthen your OpenText expertise, or identify your next joint go-to-market play, OpenText World gives you the connections and insight to turn your ambition into action.


## **Get inspired**


All conference attendees will have the opportunity to hear from[Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman in his keynote address.](https://blogs.opentext.com/artemis-ii-commander-reid-wiseman-to-headline-opentext-world-2026) As the commander of the first crewed mission to travel around the moon since Apollo 17, Wiseman offers a unique perspective on innovation and exploration. Don’t miss this opportunity to hear how Wiseman leveraged information to navigate uncertainty and achieve extraordinary outcomes.


Join us October 19-22 in Orlando and discover what’s possible when you expand your skills, your view, your reach, and your business at OpenText World 2026.


[Register today!](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?environment=P2)
